label: Handheld 3D Laser Scanner
description: A portable device that uses non-contact laser geometry to capture high-accuracy 3D meshes of fossils and dig sites.

components.function: Projects a grid of light to calculate surface depth.
Applies high-resolution color texture to the 3D mesh.
Allows 'point-and-shoot' scanning in tight museum drawers.

game_mechanics.scanning_mini_game: Player must move the scanner in a 'painting' motion. If they move too fast, the tracking is lost; if too slow, the file size becomes unmanageable.
game_mechanics.spatial_reconstruction: Allows the player to 're-visit' the dig site in VR/Digital mode to see the original orientation of the bones.
